## Research status

**Technical owners.** 3 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Recursive Self-Improvement Boundaries](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/recursive-self-improvement-boundaries.html), [Open-Ended Improvement Engines](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/open-ended-improvement-engines.html), [Autonomous Replication, Proliferation, and Containment](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/autonomous-replication-proliferation-and-containment.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 11.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** Competing architectures that achieve equal improvement, reversibility, descendant control, and incident recovery with fewer authority boundaries would justify simplification.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
